items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) exited late and ruled out; MRI pending, late timing noted by Levitan.
items.why: Knee injury third quarter; not available postgame; Vrabel awaiting MRI.
items.implication: Potential multi-week; NE backfield to Kiner/Larison with Henderson also out illness.

items.text: Full Sunday watch: Nacua knee, Mahomes elbow returned + Worthy ham, Stevenson knee, Jacobs hand, Waddle conc, McConkey back + Herbert, McCarthy hip returned, Willis groin returned, Ferguson/Goodson knee; added Lock oblique.
items.why: Comprehensive post-Sunday list for fantasy impact.
items.implication: Prioritize status changes into Week 10; beneficiaries on OUT.

items.text: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the Rams’ final offensive snap Sunday and will undergo MRI Monday; team does not believe he tore his ACL.
items.why: Late-game knee injury after 14-150-1; initial belief ACL intact per Schefter/Garafolo.
items.implication: Major blow to Rams offense already without Davante Adams; monitor MRI for Week 10 availability.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Rams WRs if sidelined.

items.text: Patrick Mahomes is day-to-day with right elbow injury sustained Sunday; Andy Reid says more positive than negative, rehabbing soreness after MRI showed no major damage.
items.why: Elbow strain/sprain; returned to game; MRI clean of major issues.
items.implication: Monitor swelling/pain for Week 10; likely plays but watch practice.

items.text: Sam Darnold ruled out Week 10 vs Raiders (quad/ribs); Drew Lock oblique tests good/minor, expected to start.
items.why: Macdonald: Darnold out; Lock oblique minor, can manage/start.
items.implication: Lock starts; SEA offense continuity watch.

items.text: Notable RB splits: Hall 19 opp vs Allen 10 (Allen outsnapped 37-27); Coleman 58 snaps/dominant vs Dobbins last 2 wks; Charbonnet outsnapped/routed Price; Jeanty 32 snaps/24 routes vs Washington in trail.
items.why: Post-game opportunity and snap/route data showing clear hierarchies or recoveries.
items.implication: Hall lead back returning; Coleman clear lead DEN; Charbonnet preferred SEA; Jeanty workhorse even trailing.
items.opportunity: Snaps/routes/carries favor listed leads; handcuff Allen if Hall limited.

items.text: Justin Herbert to undergo testing on left (non-throwing) middle finger; could be fracture per Harbaugh; Herbert expects to play next week.
items.why: Injured stiff-arming; exited late; non-throwing hand, similar to prior.
items.implication: Likely available MNF vs BAL; monitor tests. Ladd McConkey also back issue.

items.text: Josh Jacobs fractured a finger (right ring) and did not return; Packers hope to find way for him to play through it with protection.
items.why: Hand caught in facemask; LaFleur optimistic on playing with it.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup opportunity if limited; monitor for Week 10.
items.opportunity: Increased work for Packers RBs if Jacobs limited or out.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) exited after high-low hit and ruled out; entered protocol. Bye week aids recovery.
items.why: Violent hit; mandatory concussion protocol; Payton no serious injuries believed.
items.implication: Miss remainder; clear protocol for post-bye. DEN WRs see bump short-term.

items.text: Tightest two-player target concentrations: NYG Nabers+Likely 54.9%; ARI McBride+Wilson 50.7%; DAL Lamb+Pickens 50.6%; DET Amon-Ra+LaPorta 49.3%; GB Golden+Watson 48.7%. Tee+Chase 47.3%.
items.why: Season-long target share data to two players.
items.implication: High floor/ceiling for those pairs; volatility if one misses (e.g. Pickens).

items.text: JJ McCarthy hip pointer; Giants confident ready for TNF vs Washington; Harbaugh says looking good to play.
items.why: Hip pointer Sunday; returned; early positive for Thursday.

items.text: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) and Ladd McConkey (back) among Sunday injuries watched; Mahomes returned, Herbert undisclosed.
items.why: Exited or limited; added to ETR multi-player list with Lock.
items.implication: KC/LAC skill depth chart shifts if miss time.

items.text: Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Matthew Golden explosion bananas/impressive; huge days.
items.implication: Start/upgrade GB pass catchers ROS if sustained.
items.opportunity: High target/route share in exploding offense.

items.text: Tank Dell huge day; easy guy to root for, love seeing utilization.
items.why: Strong performance and rooting interest post-injury return context.
